title: 第25章 前往沧澜学院行踪暴露第26章 葬天剑之威瞬杀造化境
content_zh:
第25章前往沧澜学院，行踪暴露
“公孙冶，你当我不存在吗？”
柳青脸色阴沉，公孙冶竟然还想对林尘出手。
“柳青，你应该知道，此子保不住！
相反，你还要承受慕容秀的怒火，如此做法，对你柳家有何好处？”
“慕容秀，黄口小儿罢了，我会惧他？”
柳青轻蔑一笑，大禹学院确实强大，但柳家也不是软柿子。
柳青在外行事，绝不能丢了面子。
而且，柳青对林尘的看法已经改变。
林尘击败苏瑶的时候，柳青还没有如此动容。
苏瑶毕竟只是刚刚达到灵海境，而且武魂并不稳。
但，林尘镇杀慕容光，在没有武魂的状态下，能有如此壮举，简直恐怖，放眼大禹皇城，能做到的人都不多。
柳青怀疑，林尘的身上有秘密。
或许，他的武魂已经恢复，也未可知。
无论如何，柳青今日必须将林尘保下来。
“很好！
柳青，今日之事，我会如实告知慕容秀！”
公孙冶冷哼一声，转身离去。
柳青深深看了林尘一眼：“你若愿意加入柳家，可以成为柳家内堂弟子，以后表现出色，有机会迎娶柳家嫡系小姐。”
柳青眼中有一抹期待之色，开出了不俗的条件。

外姓之人加入柳家，能直接成为内堂弟子的，并不多。
“抱歉，我暂时没有去柳家的想法。”
林尘抱了抱拳，郑重道。
柳青的眼神，让林尘心中不安。
若是去到柳家，林尘担心，柳家派人研究他的武魂，对他不利！
倒不是林尘不信任柳嫣然，而是不想立于危墙之下。
去柳家，并非明智之举。
“以后若想好了，柳家，随时欢迎你。”
柳青摇了摇头，眼中难免失望之色。
他承认，自己之前看走眼了。
如果柳青一开始就拉拢林尘，而不是心存轻视，或许林尘的态度会有所不同。
“林公子，保重。”
柳嫣然眼神黯然，虽然心中不舍，但也理解林尘的选择。
林尘的身上，秘密太多。
content_en:
Chapter 25 Go to Canglan College, whereabouts are exposed
"Gongsun Ye, do you think I don't exist?"
Liu Qing's face was gloomy, Gongsun Ye actually wanted to take action against Lin Chen.
"Liu Qing, you should know that this son can't be saved!
On the contrary, you have to bear Murong Xiu's anger. What benefit will this do to your Liu family? "
"Murong Xiu, he's just a kid with a yellow mouth. Will I be afraid of him?"
Liu Qing smiled contemptuously. Dayu Academy is indeed powerful, but the Liu family is not a soft persimmon.
Liu Qing must not lose face when acting outside.
Moreover, Liu Qing's view of Lin Chen had changed.
When Lin Chen defeated Su Yao, Liu Qing was not so moved.
After all, Su Yao has just reached the spiritual sea realm, and her martial soul is not stable.
However, Lin Chen was able to achieve such a feat by suppressing Murong Guang without a martial spirit. It was simply terrifying. Looking at the Imperial City of Dayu, there were not many people who could do it.
Liu Qing suspected that Lin Chen had a secret.
Perhaps, his martial spirit has recovered, it is unknown.
No matter what, Liu Qing must save Lin Chen today.
"Very good!
Liu Qing, I will tell Murong Xiu truthfully what happened today! "
Gongsun Ye snorted coldly, turned around and left.
Liu Qing took a deep look at Lin Chen and said, "If you are willing to join the Liu family, you can become a disciple of the Liu family's inner hall. If you perform well in the future, you will have the opportunity to marry a direct lady of the Liu family."
There was a look of expectation in Liu Qing's eyes, and she made good terms.
When people with other surnames join the Liu family, not many can directly become inner disciples.
"Sorry, I have no idea of going to Liu's house for the time being."
Lin Chen clasped his fists and said solemnly.
Liu Qing's eyes made Lin Chen feel uneasy.
If he goes to the Liu family, Lin Chen is worried that the Liu family will send people to study his martial spirit, which will be detrimental to him!
It wasn't that Lin Chen didn't trust Liu Yanran, but that he didn't want to stand under a dangerous wall.
Going to the Liu family is not a wise move.
"If you think about it in the future, the Liu family will welcome you at any time."
Liu Qing shook her head, with a look of disappointment in her eyes.
He admitted that he had been wrong before.
If Liu Qing had won over Lin Chen from the beginning, instead of showing contempt, perhaps Lin Chen's attitude would have been different.
"Master Lin, take care."
Liu Yanran's eyes were filled with sadness. Although she was reluctant to give up, she understood Lin Chen's choice.
Lin Chen had too many secrets.
